rules.title: Rules and connection guide
rules.deck: Two standard decks plus one Dragon, Phoenix, Dog, and Mahjong: 108 cards, 18 per player. Teams alternate A–B–A–B–A–B.
rules.bombs: A bomb is exactly four cards of one rank, or a straight flush of at least five cards. Equal bombs cannot beat each other. The Phoenix cannot be used in a bomb.
rules.calls: See ten cards, decide Large Tichu (±200), then receive eight more. Exchange one card with each teammate. Call Small Tichu (±100) before playing your first card. Only the caller finishing first succeeds; otherwise their team loses 100/200 points, even if a teammate finishes first.
rules.scoring: A triple victory scores 300; the target is 1,000. Card points total 200. The Dog passes the lead to a teammate; a Dragon trick goes to an opponent.
rules.serverTitle: Your game stays on the server
rules.server: Choose a room to play or watch. Games are saved on the server and continue when the creator leaves. Reload in the same browser or choose Rejoin to reclaim your seat.
rules.reconnect: During play, disconnected seats wait up to 3 minutes before the 30-second turn limit. Reconnect to play yourself. Lobby, declarations and exchange keep the 45-second grace. Clearing browser data removes your reconnection key.

play.autoDragonHelp: Choose an opponent within 5 seconds. Otherwise the next opposing seat receives the trick.
play.autoCollectHelp: The trick is collected automatically after 5 seconds.
play.exchangeLocked: Exchange confirmed. You can select and confirm replacement cards until everyone confirms. If everyone finishes while you are editing, your last confirmed cards are exchanged.
play.exchangeEditable: You can select and confirm replacement cards until everyone completes the exchange.
patches.gameFlow: Clearer calls and passes, automatic turns and post-match trick review.
rules.timers: Turns last at most 30 seconds, then automatically pass. When passing is illegal, a legal move is made. Tricks collect automatically after 5 seconds. Disconnected players get up to 3 minutes to reconnect, then a 30-second turn. Reconnecting sooner starts the 30-second turn immediately.
rules.history: Only current-trick history is visible during play. Review each trick after the 1,000-point match ends. Exchange choices can be changed and confirmed again until everyone has confirmed.
patches.mobileLabels: Clearer exchange, pass and Phoenix labels, with up to 3 minutes to reconnect during play.
